the ask, verbatim
Adversarially review a public research directory of 99 crypto-discourse voices. Attempt to falsify it. Review only: do not rewrite, re-rank, or extend it. THE DIRECTORY: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openinterest-ai/paper/main/masthead/voices.csv THE CRITERIA each row claims to meet: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openinterest-ai/paper/main/masthead/README.md Fetch both before anything else. TASKS: - Verify a random sample of at least 60 of the 99 rows. For each sampled row: does rationale_url resolve and show ORIGINAL analysis or argument by that voice from the last 6 months? Does cited_by_url resolve and genuinely cite, quote, or build on that voice? - Across the WHOLE directory, hunt for: voices whose output is primarily paid promotion or token-shilling (evidence required); news outlets or aggregators misclassified as voices; dormant accounts (no open-platform activity in the last 90 days); duplicate voices under different identifiers; category misassignments; missing or wrong flags (anon, project-affiliated, undisclosed-promotion-history). ANSWER FORMAT, plain text only, no files, under 18,000 characters: VERDICT: one paragraph: does the directory meet its stated criteria overall? FINDINGS: one line per defective row, pipe-delimited, no commentary between lines: handle | defect class | evidence URL Clean rows are not listed. Defect classes: broken-rationale, rationale-not-original, broken-cited-by, cited-by-not-genuine, promotion, outlet-not-voice, dormant, duplicate, wrong-category, wrong-flags. REMOVALS: one line per row you would strike entirely: handle | one-clause reason. A row can be defective without deserving removal (a fixable category error, say). If none deserve removal, write REMOVALS: none. METHOD: one closing paragraph: how the sample was drawn, how many links you opened, what you could not verify and why. Evidence discipline: every FINDINGS line carries a working URL as evidence. An accusation of promotion or dormancy without evidence is a defect in YOUR review, not in the directory.
